title: ProcTHOR: Large-Scale Embodied AI Using Procedural Generation
models_tested: ProcTHOR-Large (Custom CNN+RNN with larger CLIP backbone)
findings: This paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on training embodied AI agents for navigation and manipulation tasks in procedurally generated virtual environments.
